m6.intro_first_line:
ROOK
That ledger you brought me? It names Kingfish — every dollar he skimmed, every cop he bought. Now he wants it back.
ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Pick up the package on PALM BLVD
stage_lines: EDDIE | Rook sends his runners, I fix their rides. This one's clean, kid. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Deliver the package to Eddie's garage on CORAL WAY
stage_lines: SILAS | Kingfish's boys are asking questions at every bar on the south island. Keep your head down — for now. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Check in with Silas on MARINA DR
stage_lines: ROOK | Clean run. The bay's starting to know your name. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT
SILAS | Word travels fast on this bay. Kingfish is asking about Rook's new runner. That is you, kid. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

m7.intro_first_line:
ROOK
Kingfish's boys are shaking down my bar's suppliers on BAY ST. Same crew that skimmed my drops in M2 — time they learned whose street this is.
ENTER / KLIK

stage_log.text: Go to the docks on BAY ST
stage_lines: KINGFISH | You think a pistol makes you somebody? My boys collect — or they bury. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Deal with Kingfish's collectors on BAY ST (0/3)
stage_lines: ROOK | Every dollar they skimmed off my suppliers — pick it up, all of it. Do not leave a cent on that street. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Collect the skimmed cash on BAY ST
stage_lines: ROOK | Every dollar back. Kingfish just paid for his own lesson. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Bring the cash back to Rook on OCEAN AVE
stage_lines: ROOK | The docks are quiet tonight. Kingfish will not forget this — neither will I. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT
KINGFISH | You took my boys and my money, kid. The bay pays ME — and now YOU owe me. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

m8.intro_first_line:
EDDIE
Kingfish torched my cousin's shop last night. Tonight we answer — with horsepower.
ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Drive the getaway Comet across BRIDGE RD to the north island
stage_lines: SILAS | They're coming in from the pier! Hold the line, kid — the boat's almost loaded! | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Hold off Kingfish's crew on MARINA DR (0/3)
stage_lines: EDDIE | Bring her home to Palm Blvd in one piece — she is the fastest thing I ever built, and she is yours to keep safe. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Deliver the Comet to the safehouse on PALM BLVD
stage_lines: EDDIE | She's in one piece. You're learning, kid. The bay is yours to take. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT
SILAS | The Comet made it. The whole marina saw it, kid. The whole bay will hear it. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

m9.intro_first_line:
CALLOWAY
Off the record, kid. That ledger you gave Rook names me as the one cop Kingfish could NOT buy. So now he wants me gone too.
ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Steal the payoff book from the marina office on MARINA DR
stage_lines: KINGFISH | You brought the LAW to my docks?! Nobody crosses Kingfish and walks away! | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Survive the ambush on CORAL WAY (0/3)
stage_lines: CALLOWAY | Bring the book to me on Bay St — and do not let Kingfish's boys see you carry it. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Deliver the payoff book to Calloway on BAY ST
stage_lines: CALLOWAY | This book buries him. You did the bay a favour tonight — don't expect a medal, expect a target on your back. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT
ROOK | A cop, kid? Careful. The bay remembers who it owes — and who it owns. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

m10.intro_first_line:
ROOK
Tonight it ends. Kingfish, his crew, all of it — at the marina. The payoff book gave Calloway the warrants; we give him the arrest.
ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Confront Kingfish at the marina on MARINA DR
stage_lines: KINGFISH | FINE. You want the bay? Come and TAKE it! | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Take down Kingfish's crew on MARINA DR (0/4)
stage_lines: CALLOWAY | Every unit in the bay is on you — five stars, air support. Get across that bridge and DON'T stop! | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Escape across BRIDGE RD — lose the cops, lose the heli
stage_lines: ROOK | You did it, kid. Kingfish is finished — the bay is YOURS now. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

stage_log.text: Reach the safehouse on OCEAN AVE
stage_lines: ROOK | CH.4 — STORM SURGE complete. Kingfish is finished, the ledger is ours, and the bay has a new name on it. Yours. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT
ROOK | Azure Bay is yours now, kid. CH.1 to CH.4 — the whole arc, done. | ENTER / KLIK — LANJUT

active.stageText: Pick up the stash on CORAL WAY (west)
